name: techne
description: AJ's plugins for AI coding agents: code-repo skills (techne), document builds (graphe), bibliography verification (dokimasia), idea triage (heuresis), git guards (phylax), Gmail across accounts (epistole), Brightspace course sites (schole), and a spoken Claude Code (keryx).

plugins.name: techne
plugins.description: Code-repo skills: toolchain audits, CI log review, adversarial pre-merge review, commit planning, GitHub catch-up, a cross-repo project board, cross-repo drift, slop cleanup, and doc/code drift.

plugins.name: graphe
plugins.description: Document skills: build and gate LaTeX papers, markdown-to-PDF renders and talk decks, scaffold a research paper, and run a pre-submission novelty review.

plugins.name: dokimasia
plugins.description: Bibliography verification for LaTeX projects: an offline lint of any .bib or hand-written thebibliography, an online verify against arXiv and Crossref that tells a failed lookup from a wrong entry, and a check that every cited key rendered.

plugins.name: phylax
plugins.description: Opt-in Claude Code hooks: refuse attribution lines in commits and PRs, refuse staging COMMITS.md, warn on commits in a main checkout, and restart idle sessions onto an updated Claude Code.

plugins.name: epistole
plugins.description: Gmail across accounts for Claude Code: search, read and draft in every configured account, and send a draft only after you approve it.

plugins.name: heuresis
plugins.description: Idea triage: capture an idea, search papers, patents, products and your own work, and file it with a verdict grounded in checked records.

plugins.name: schole
plugins.description: Read-only Brightspace (D2L) course sites: new announcements and content, what is due, and what came due unsubmitted, through the site's API after one browser sign-in.

plugins.name: keryx
plugins.description: Speaks a short gist of each Claude Code reply in a local voice, one voice per terminal, ducking Spotify while it talks. WSL2 on Windows only.
